tests_run: npm run test:emulator (firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage,functions 'npm test')
summary: Backend security fixes, all verified by real emulator paths (139/139 pass). guest_list.ts now filters role==='guest' AND status==='active' so tv/host deviceIds never leak (e2e test proves exclusion incl. revoked hosts). host_join.ts mints a 6-digit pairingCode alongside the token (salted SHA-256 hash stored, same 5-min TTL), joinHost requires both halves with identical generic FORBIDDEN on wrong/missing code (no oracle), enforces max 3 active hosts per party, supersedes older pending invites on mint, records redeemedFromInviteId/redeemedAt, and adds TV-only revokeHostDevice (demote + hostAudit record; revoked hosts fail the registered-host gate). host_media.ts getHostVideoPreview re-reads seed + job hostDeleted inside a transaction (gate before copy, gate + status/previewPaths write in the same commit transaction), rejects deleted/failed/expired seeds, maps purged-source copy failure to typed NOT_FOUND. delivery.ts acknowledgeDelivery eagerly materializes hostPreviews copies before purge (lazy path kept as retry). guest_upload.ts enforces namespaced consent (guests v1/guest_cameo, hosts host_source_v1/host_source with attestation copy, never mixed). retention.ts expires lapsed pending hostInvites. security_rules.test.ts uses hosted @firebase/rules-unit-testing asserts (firestore read/write/list + storage read/write/list/delete) for unauthenticated, device-authed, and cross-party contexts; fixture PIN replaced with obviously-fake 000000 + placeholder note. EXPECTATIONS OUTSIDE PARTITION (not edited): generation_store.ts, publish.ts, generation.ts, guest_media.ts still hardcode the v1/guest_cameo pair in their eligibility gates and must additionally accept host_source_v1/host_source (same isSupportedConsent semantics); publish.ts should also trigger eager preview materialization at ready/publish transition (currently covered in acknowledgeDelivery); configure a Firestore TTL policy on hostInvites.expiresAt at deploy level (sweep is defense-in-depth); TV/recovery UI wiring for pairingCode display and revoke is fix-2's file, callable + export already provided here.
